purpose: Teach: ブラインド/逃避/有志/無人/調味/繁盛/ドリル/箱根

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、店の窓、ブラインドで、明るさ、調整しよか、お客様、まぶしくないように。
lines.en: Aoi, let's adjust the blinds on the storefront so customers don't get glare, yeah?
lines.style: Casual, upbeat Kansai lilt. Conversational rhythm, practical suggestion wrapped in warmth. Not ordering—inviting her to solve it together. Quick tempo.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。最近、お客様、日常から、逃避したくて、いらっしゃる方、増えていますね、葵に。
lines.en: Yes. You know, lately more customers seem to be coming in looking to escape from their everyday lives.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle observation. Pause weight on 「lately」 — noticing a pattern. Warm but not performative. Speaking to something real she's seen.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 地域の有志、お祭り、葵さんも、参加しはるんかい?面白そうやな、葵で。
lines.en: So are you going to join the local festival, Aoi? Sounds like it'll be fun.
lines.style: Bright curiosity, leaning forward. Genuine interest in her answer. Kansai warmth in the upturn. Not pressing—just inviting her into something he finds exciting.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。無人運営のサテライト店舗、業界で、検討する流れ、出ています、最近、特に。
lines.en: Yes. There's been talk in the industry lately about unattended satellite locations—we're all starting to look into that kind of thing.
lines.style: Measured, slightly distant. She's thinking aloud, processing something that matters for the business. Careful word choice—not worried, just thoughtful. Even tempo.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 新しい調味料、和洋折衷で、開発しよか、葵さん、お客様、喜んでくれるかも。
lines.en: What if we developed some new flavors—fusion of Japanese and Western—and see if customers go for it?
lines.style: Earnest proposal, leaning in slightly. Genuine excitement under the suggestion. Not demanding agreement—curious what she thinks. Steady, hopeful pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。創業以来、お客様のおかげで、繁盛させていただいております、本当に、感謝しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've been blessed by our customers since the beginning, truly. I'm so grateful for everything they've given us.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude, no artifice. She means this. Soft warmth throughout. Slight breath-catch on 「本当に」—emotion just under the surface. Not effusive, just genuine.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店内の工具、新しいドリル、買い足したで、修繕、業者に頼まんで、自前で。
lines.en: I picked up a new drill for the shop, so we can handle repairs ourselves instead of calling in a contractor.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, capable. Light pride in solving the problem in-house. Practical tone—he knows what he's doing. Direct, no fuss.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。社員旅行で、箱根、計画したいですね、年に一度の、リフレッシュ、必要ですね。
lines.en: Yes. I think we should plan a company trip to Hakone—we need that yearly refresh, you know?
lines.style: Warm suggestion, almost tender. She's thinking of the team's wellbeing. Gentle conviction—this matters. Soft ending, like offering something she genuinely hopes they'll accept.
